lines.t:
An {{effect}} that raises each <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c> according to
how high the <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c> is, and its numerical value.
One third of the {{medal_level}} is added to all skill
levels, even for untrained <c:ffff00>skills<c>.
<c:ffff00>{{medalia}}<c> also have a {{level_bonus}} (0 to 99), which
raises their extra <c:ffff00>{{best_skill}}<c> (1 type per {{medalia}}).
